episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Homer's engaging tale recounts the journey of Odysseus, king of Ithaca & mastermind of the Greek victory in the Trojan War. Surviving ten years of challenges sent by the angry gods, he makes his way home to his kingdom, loyal wife & son with something more valuable than the spoils of war: wisdom.
